name: Andaz Singapore
positioning: Andre Fu-designed lifestyle hotel with shophouse-inspired rooms, tucked between Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led city base near Kampong Glam
Guests who want skyline, sea or heritage views and easy MRT access

facts.text: The hotel is tucked between the Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah Bugis neighbourhoods.
The hotel was designed by Andre Fu.
The hotel lobby is on the 25th floor.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Singapore skyline.
Mango yellow shophouse doors divide the bathroom from the sleeping area, echoing the nearby heritage buildings.
The bath products were created for the hotel by French perfumer Christophe Laudamiel.
Rooms have a complimentary minibar with snacks and non-alcoholic beverages.
Guests have access to complimentary refreshments at the Sunroom.
The hotel has an infinity pool.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.
Alley on 25 is an all-day restaurant that recreates the experience of Singapore street dining in the sky.
665°F on level 38 serves a meat-centric menu with Southeast Asian flavours.

highlights.text: Mr. Stork is a rooftop bar on level 39 with 360-degree city views and 10 teepee huts inspired by the nests of its namesake bird.
Room and suite interiors are inspired by the traditional shophouses of the Kampong Glam neighbourhood.
Heritage view rooms look over the historic landmarks of Kampong Glam.
Deluxe sea view rooms look out to the coast of Singapore through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Lifts near reception on level 25 lead down to Bugis MRT station (Exit E).

considerations.text: There is no complimentary car park access; the car park is managed by DUO Tower.
Pets are not allowed, except service animals.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with potential street noise.
